tools.name: planningcenter_list_people
tools.description: List people in the Planning Center People database. Search by name or email, then page with offset. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_get_person
tools.description: Get one person by id, with optional related records (emails, phone_numbers, households, field_data). Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the Person record of the Planning Center user who created the Personal Access Token. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_lists
tools.description: List People lists (saved groups of people, such as volunteers or new members). Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_get_list
tools.description: Get one People list by id, including its name, total people and refresh status. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_people_in_list
tools.description: List the people in one People list. Page with per_page and offset. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_service_types
tools.description: List the service types (worship services or event flows) in Planning Center Services. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_get_service_type
tools.description: Get one service type by id. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_plans
tools.description: List plans (dated services) of one service type. Filter by future, past or no_dates. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_get_plan
tools.description: Get one plan by id: title, dates, series and status. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_plan_items
tools.description: List the items (songs, readings, media, headers) in the order of one plan. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_plan_team_members
tools.description: List the people scheduled on one plan, with their team position and status. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams (for example Vocals or Sound) of one service type. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_team_people
tools.description: List the people on one team, with their team positions. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_person_schedules
tools.description: List the upcoming or past service assignments of one person. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_search_songs
tools.description: Search the song library by title, sorted by title or last scheduled date. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_get_song
tools.description: Get one song by id: title, author, CCLI number and key. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_events
tools.description: List events in Planning Center Calendar. Filter to future events or search by name. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_get_event
tools.description: Get one Calendar event by id: name, description, approval status and owner. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_groups
tools.description: List groups (small groups, teams and ministries) in Planning Center Groups. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_get_group
tools.description: Get one group by id: name, description, visibility, meeting schedule and enrollment. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_group_memberships
tools.description: List the members of one group with their role (member, leader or owner). Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_person_groups
tools.description: List the groups one person belongs to. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_group_events
tools.description: List the meetings (events) of one group. Filter canceled or not_canceled. Read only.

tools.name: planningcenter_list_event_attendances
tools.description: List the attendance records of one group meeting. Filter attended for people who came. Read only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: planningcenter_list_people, planningcenter_get_person · Private data: planningcenter_list_people, planningcenter_get_person, planningcenter_get_current_user, planningcenter_list_event_attendances · Public sink: planningcenter_list_people.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: planningcenter_list_people, planningcenter_get_person · Private data: planningcenter_list_people, planningcenter_get_person, planningcenter_get_current_user, planningcenter_list_event_attendances · Public sink: planningcenter_list_people

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
